# appsignal_check_in (Resource)

A check-in monitor in an AppSignal app. A `cron` check-in expects a check-in on a schedule; a `heartbeat` check-in expects one at least every `wait_time_minutes`. Jobs check in with the identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_check_in" "nightly_export" {
  app_id            = appsignal_app.web.id
  identifier        = "nightly-export"
  kind              = "cron"
  schedule          = "0 2 * * *"
  timezone          = "Europe/Amsterdam"
  wait_time_minutes = 15
  notifier_ids      = [data.appsignal_notifier.email.id]
}

resource "appsignal_check_in" "worker" {
  app_id            = appsignal_app.web.id
  identifier        = "queue-worker"
  kind              = "heartbeat"
  wait_time_minutes = 5
  notifier_ids      = [data.appsignal_notifier.email.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `identifier` (String) Name the job checks in as. It must be unique within the app.
- `kind` (String) `cron` or `heartbeat`. Changing it replaces the check-in and its history.
- `wait_time_minutes` (Number) Minutes after the expected time before a check-in counts as missed. At least 1.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `notifier_ids` (Set of String) Notifiers alerted when a check-in is missed. See the appsignal_notifier data source.
- `schedule` (String) Five-field cron expression, for `cron` check-ins only.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the schedule runs in, for `cron` check-ins. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_check_in.nightly_export <app_id>/<check_in_id>
```
